meta.name: cheat-bump
meta.description: 提议并执行 rubric 或 bucket 升级。两种模式：**完整 rubric bump**（最高风险动作，5 步强制 + 跨模型审核）和 **--bucket-only 轻量重校**（只换 bucket 边界，不动 rubric 公式）。**Phase 2 强制走 cheat-score-blind sub-agent 给校准池重打分**——不接受 self-scored fallback。触发词："升级 rubric"/"bump rubric"/"更新公式"/"我想加一个维度"/"调整权重"/"重校桶"/"recalibrate bucket"。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 升级评估系统的评分规则与分桶边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要调整或升级评估系统的评分规则和分桶标准。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade scoring rules and bucket boundaries for evaluation systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to adjust or upgrade scoring rules and bucket boundaries in an evaluation system.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你升级评分公式或调整播放量分桶。它会执行完整的5步验证流程（包括用另一个AI独立审核），或者只重新计算分桶边界。
howto.when: 当你提到“升级rubric”、“调整权重”、“重校桶”等关键词，或者要求修改评分规则时触发。

say.note: Claude会执行完整bump流程，包括跨模型审核。
Claude会根据最新数据重新计算播放量分桶边界。
Claude会询问具体调整方案，然后走完整bump。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you upgrade the scoring formula or adjust play count buckets. It will execute a full 5-step validation process (including independent review by another AI) or only recalculate bucket boundaries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "upgrade rubric", "adjust weights", "recalibrate bucket", or ask to modify scoring rules.

say_en.note: Claude will run full bump with cross-model audit.
Claude will recalculate bucket boundaries based on latest data.

say_en.text: I think ER is too low, I want to adjust it
say_en.note: Claude will ask for specific changes then run full bump.
